articles.summary: Just in the last 7 days, we've seen LiteLLM and axios impacted by supply chain attacks. Recently, I was chatting with Bereket Engida, the creator of the popular JS auth library. He observed repeated attempts by a contributor to add malicious code directly via a pull request.
articles.title: The Blueprint of a North Korean Attack on Open-Source

articles.summary: Most security professionals pack for RSA like they're heading to Vegas in February. Wrong coast, wrong weather, wrong strategy. Here's everything you need to know.
articles.title: What to Pack for RSAC 2026
